clips.description: One subtle 12-frame combat-ready weight-shift cycle. Feet planted in a stable guard, knees soft, arms ready, gentle breath. Return smoothly to the starting guard at frame 12.

One continuous crouch-to-standing transition. Begin deep crouch with arms forward. Gradually straighten knees and hips, lower arms, end upright relaxed. Both feet planted. Preserve body and head sizes as joints extend.

One jump takeoff. Frames 1-3 lower knees in anticipation. Frames 4-6 push off and extend ankles. Frames 7-9 rise with knees folding. Frames 10-12 settle into airborne ascent. No landing. The root remains centered; local leg poses convey flight, game physics moves the body.

One airborne falling pose loop, knees slightly bent, boots down, elbows out to balance, coat and braid streaming upward slightly. Tiny continuous cloth motion. Same torso position throughout, no jump takeoff or landing, last frame flows into first.

One landing and recovery. Frames 1-2 airborne boots nearly reaching baseline. Frames 3-4 boots touch and knees flex. Frames 5-6 deepest compression. Frames 7-12 gradually stand upright. Boots stay fixed on the baseline after contact. Preserve body proportions; no floor or dust.

One standing damage flinch without blood or impact effect. Frames 1-2 upright ready. Frames 3-4 recoil backward to left from a hit arriving from right, head and chest snap back, feet stay planted. Frames 5-6 hold maximum recoil. Frames 7-12 gradually recover to starting stance.

One CROUCHED damage flinch. Remain deeply crouched for the entire sequence. Begin crouched guard, recoil shoulders and head backward slightly from a right-side impact, settle back to crouched guard. Knees remain bent, feet planted. Never stand, no blood or FX.

One AIRBORNE damage recoil. Begin suspended knees bent, recoil chest and head left, limbs open from force, curl back into balanced falling pose. Keep pelvis centered at a fixed point; only limbs and torso move. No ground contact and no complete somersault, no blood or FX.

One damage recoil from BEHIND. Face right throughout. Begin standing, impact from LEFT makes chest and head lurch forward to RIGHT, knees bend slightly, then recover upright. Boots planted. No turn, no blood, no effect.
One guarded stance breathing loop. Both forearms held firmly protecting face and chest throughout. Knees bent slightly, boots planted. Small consistent breath only; never lower the guard in the loop.

One blocked-hit recoil. Begin forearms guarding face and chest, compress slightly backward under a single hit, shoulders tense, then smoothly return to same guard. Remain facing right. No shield bubble or particles, no opponent.

One quick forward melee JAB. Frames 1-3 draw striking arm back slightly from ready stance. Frames 4-5 extend the near fist or weapon pommel sharply to RIGHT at chest height for contact. Frames 6-12 retract progressively back to the starting ready stance. Feet planted, small torso twist, no projectile or slash effect.

One rising UPPERCUT melee strike. Frames 1-3 bend knees and lower striking arm. Frames 4-5 drive striking fist/weapon upward above shoulder height. Frames 6-12 lower arm and recover to starting stance. Both boots stay close to ground. No jump, no energy effect, no second character.

One AIRBORNE forward melee strike. Character remains suspended with bent knees and pelvis centered. Frames 1-3 wind striking arm back, frames 4-5 sweep fist or held weapon horizontally to RIGHT, frames 6-12 retract into the initial airborne ready pose. No ground contact, no slash overlay, no other person.

One heavy forward melee THRUST. Frames 1-6 progressively crouch and pull fist/held weapon back with a strong twist. Frames 7-8 deliver an extended forceful strike toward RIGHT. Frames 9-16 gradually retract, straighten and return to ready. The hit uses the fist or weapon as a melee object, not a projectile. Boots maintain ground baseline. No FX or second person.

One forward GRAB attempt. Start ready, free hand opens and reaches to right at chest height, closes as if grasping an invisible opponent, then withdraws to ready. Keep the second hand near chest. No actual opponent, no rope, no projectile.

One forward THROW gesture with no other person drawn. Start hands forward as if gripping, draw hands inward with torso loading left, then extend arms forcefully RIGHT and release open palm, then settle into ready stance. Clear smooth anticipation, release and recovery.

One horizontal CAST. Start ready, raise casting hand or pistol-wand progressively to aim RIGHT, hold aim briefly, show small recoil in arm only, lower hand back to ready. No projectile, muzzle flash, glowing effect or other objects; those are separate layers.

One PICKUP gesture. Start standing, bend knees and torso, reach empty free hand down toward the ground, close hand as if grasping an invisible small item, then straighten smoothly to standing. No item drawn, boots planted.

One dizzy STUN loop. Feet planted. Head and shoulders gently sway from left to right and back, arms hang loose, knees softened. Keep face right, no full turn. Small motion with continuous last-to-first transition, no stars or effect icons.

One DEFEAT kneel. Start upright with shoulders sagging. Slowly sink onto one knee, lower head and hands, end resting bowed in a defeated kneeling posture. No fall offscreen, no blood, no hat disappearing, no return to standing.

One second airborne jump. Begin already airborne with bent knees; compress, thrust arms and legs outward upward, then collect legs and settle into apex pose. Smooth twelve-frame progress, no grounded crouch.

One twelve-frame subtle loop of a downward streamlined fall. Torso upright, legs mostly extended downward, arms tucked close, coat and braid pushed upward by air. Same posture with small cloth motion throughout; no landing.

One airborne evasive sideways tuck and untuck, twelve chronological drawings. Start falling, curl knees and arms close, lean torso sideways, sweep backward, then reopen to stable falling pose. Body always airborne and facing right; no ground roll.
Twelve-frame subtle breathing loop clinging against an invisible vertical wall on the right. Both hands extended right, feet braced right, knees bent. Stay in this pose throughout; no wall drawn.

Twelve-frame breathing loop hanging below an invisible ledge on the right. One free hand grips at upper right, arm extended, body hanging down, feet dangling. Keep attachment position constant, no terrain drawn.

Twelve-frame airborne downward kick. Begin falling guard, tuck knees, drive one boot vertically down, follow through, then retract to falling guard. No ground contact.

Sixteen-frame low sweeping strike. Start ready, crouch, extend one leg low to right, rotate hips through a low sweep, bend knee back under body, rise into ready stance. No whole-body spinning in place.

Twelve-frame upward cast. Raise weapon hand or open palm to aim straight UP, hold full extension briefly, small recoil at wrist, lower back into ready stance. No projectile or flash.
Twelve-frame throw of an unseen opponent vertically UP. Start grip forward, dip knees, gather hand close, push hand above head, release upward, recover to standing. Draw only Ilyra.
Twelve-frame downward slam of an unseen opponent. Begin grip forward, raise arm slightly, bend knees and drive open hand down and right, then recover to standing. Draw only Ilyra, no impact effect.
Twelve-frame downward cast. Angle wrist and forearm to point weapon or open palm straight DOWN beside forward boot, brace, small recoil, then return to ready stance. No projectile or flash.
Twelve-frame cast toward 45 degrees UP RIGHT. Raise aiming arm smoothly, extend weapon or open palm diagonally, small recoil, return to ready stance. No projectile or flash.
Twelve-frame cast toward 45 degrees DOWN RIGHT. Lower aiming arm smoothly, extend weapon or open palm diagonally, small recoil, return to ready stance. No projectile or flash.

Twelve-frame mischievous beckoning gesture. Ready stance, tilt head, raise free hand and curl fingers twice subtly toward self, then lower hand and return to ready stance. Keep costume and anatomy consistent.

One complete twelve-frame low crouch-walking cycle. Remain in a deep squat, back low, hands forward. Advance near foot in the first half, then far foot in the second half. Continuous small steps and bob with no standing.

Twelve-frame guard-break reaction. Start tight forearm guard, suddenly open arms and stagger back, head recoils, knees buckle, then finish dazed but still standing. No breaking shield or particles in this body layer.

Twelve-frame nearly motionless chilled standing loop. Body stiff, shoulders raised, arms tight to chest, minute shivering motion, breath held. Keep original outfit colors. NO ICE drawn; the ice shell is a separate effect layer.

Twelve-frame distressed heat-reaction loop. Flinch and recoil shoulders, stamp one boot lightly, hunch then lift head, return to initial guarded posture. NO FIRE drawn; flames are a separate effect layer.
Twelve-frame restrained struggle loop. Torso leans slightly forward, arms held outward by invisible captor, pull shoulders back then forward, boots remain braced. No other person or rope drawn.
Twelve-frame release from an invisible right-side ledge. Begin hanging by extended free hand, open fingers, let arm fall, collect knees and settle into falling guard. No terrain drawn.
